Support this work

Laws that protect animals are on the books. How far they are applied is rarely measured.

Animal Crime Bureau (ACB) is an independent legal investigation organization. It documents crimes against animals and measures how the law is applied against the standard the law itself names.

Fund or partner

To fund Animal Crime Bureau or work with it, write to info@animalcrimebureau.org.

Write to Animal Crime Bureau

The work

  • LawLaws in the Arabic text published in the Official Gazette, with an English translation and Animal Crime Bureau’s measurement.
  • Case RegisterThis register gives each incident that Animal Crime Bureau documents or verifies a fixed number and one standard format, so that it can be cited and counted.
  • PublicationsAnimal Crime Bureau publishes in three numbered series: investigation reports, methods and working papers. Every publication carries a reference number.

Standards

  • Every legal finding cites the published text of the law.
  • Every publication carries a reference number.
  • Recommendations are addressed to the authority with the power to act.
  • Corrections are dated and recorded on the publication they amend.
